caveats: Importer still uses sensor depth timestamps for association
Metric scale is inherited from known TUM camera translation, not estimated from RGB
Measured and old RGB Mesh are read only for posthoc A/B; high-info fusion uses 96 frames and finer voxels
No GPU or pretrained weights; not a single RGB video solution
depth_producer: two distinct camera 7x7 grayscale patch ZNCC costs, best two source votes, >0.16 log-depth separated competitor, uniqueness margin >0.08
visual_review: Inspected actual heldout-7, heldout-92, heldout-162, free-3 and free-4 PNG. ZNCC removes substantial noisy fragments and grows the largest connected piece, but many true surfaces disappear; desk and monitor are not reliably identifiable in the candidate from independent views. Measured-depth room remains recognizable. No #74 acceptance.
next_shortest_fix: Stop tightening custom photometric filters. Prefer mature known-pose dense multiview or trained depth producer with executable weights/license, or keep measured-depth room as product baseline while RGB-only remains optional research.
